title: Most Common Course Pairs
summary: SQL: course_completions(user_id,course_id,course_name,completion_date,course_rating), unique by user/course. Keep users with at least five courses and mean rating at least four. Order each qualifying user's completions by date and count consecutive ordered course-name pairs. Return first_course, second_course, transition_count, sorted by count descending then both names ascending. Same-day ordering is not specified in the retrieved text and needs resolution if such inputs are allowed.
officialConstraints: Ratings are 1..5; user_id, course_id and rating are integers; course_name is text; completion_date is a date.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
